findings.evidence: Lines 196–213 and 282–315 hard-code `coordinateHopfAlgebra R (Fin n)` and `upperUnitriangularGroup (Fin n) A`, while `Coordinate/HopfAlgebra.lean:156`, `:287` and `FunctorOfPoints.lean:171` already provide the corresponding Hopf algebra, finite-type package, and point equivalence for arbitrary finite linearly ordered `m`.
findings.fix: Define this layer for `(m : Type u) [Fintype m] [LinearOrder m]` using `coordinateHopfAlgebra R m`; specialize only `coordinateMap`, `inclusion`, and their compatibility results to `Fin n`.
findings.issue: `groupScheme` and its standalone affine/finite-type and point API are restricted to `Fin n`, although none of these constructions requires the `GL_n` embedding.

summary: The standalone scheme and point API unnecessarily specializes the already-general upper-unitriangular Hopf algebra to `Fin n`.
